name: type
description: Type of the Chart.js visualization to render inside <med-chart>.

name: data
description: Chart.js data configuration object containing labels and datasets.

name: options
description: Chart.js options configuration object for scales, plugins, and interactions.

name: plugins
description: Array of Chart.js plugins registered for this chart instance.

name: width
description: Explicit CSS width applied to the chart container.

name: height
description: Explicit CSS height applied to the chart container.

name: responsive
description: Whether the chart resizes automatically when its container changes size.

name: ariaLabel
description: Accessible label applied to the rendered canvas element.

name: ariaLabelledBy
description: ID reference of an external element that labels the rendered canvas element.

name: styleClass
description: Additional CSS classes applied to the host container.

name: onDataSelect
description: Emitted when a user clicks or selects an active element on the chart canvas.

name: refresh
description: Updates the existing Chart.js instance with the latest data and options.

name: reinit
description: Destroys and recreates the underlying Chart.js instance.

name: getBase64Image
description: Returns the rendered chart canvas as a base64-encoded image data URL when available.
